Baked Noodles
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:49pm

Ingredients




2 1/2 cups Wide Noodles
2 Eggs, large
3 cups Milk
1/2 teaspoon Salt
2 tablespoons Butter

Preparation

1 Cook the noodles in boiling water with salt for 20 minutes. Drain. Grease a baking dish. Stir the butter into the noodles and place in baking dish. Beat the eggs well. Add the milk to them and beat again. Pour this over the noodles in the baking dish. Place in a slow oven at 325 degrees and bake for 1/2 hour.
